fact.title: Working hours: 9 a day, 48 a week
fact.claim: Delhi, Maharashtra and Karnataka cap work at 9 hours a day and 48 hours a week. Overtime is paid extra.
fact.law: State rules apply until states notify the new central rules.
fact.caveat: IT and ITES firms may be exempt in some states. Source name to be confirmed.

script.cover_1: Midnight at the desk, again. Is there a limit?
